node.title: Re: How to handle modules across different versions
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ksublondie],

It's possible to have a single common.pm and then inside it test for different versions of Perl, e.g. with [doc://$^V] or [doc://$OLD_PERL_VERSION|$]]. If you need to load different modules in different versions of Perl it can get a little more tricky, but see this thread for some potential solutions: [id://1165148]

What are the actual differences you've got in common.pm across your different versions?

Regards,
-- Hauke D
